trigger_condition: An active domain checkout or worktree is renamed (for example Hexalith.Parties-wt2), so the mapping continues to derive its identity from the directory even though the v2 declaration now supplies moduleId. The prerequisite-based deferral in spec-1-3-resolve-one-active-root-source-mapping.md:133 and deferred-work.md:352 still has not landed after Stories 1.5/1.12.
guard_snippet: Use the validated active v2 declaration to derive the canonical repository identity before generating mapping entries and duplicate guards; preserve the documented legacy fallback for non-v2 inputs. Until then, document the required root directory name in the enrollment guide and track the earlier decision explicitly.
potential_consequence: SourceMappingValidationTask.cs:113-130 and :174-178 compare packages against the directory-derived prefix: Hexalith.Parties-wt2 misses duplicate Hexalith.Parties packages, while Hexalith matches unrelated Hexalith packages. PlatformServerBindings.cs:57-63 can also fail to locate the active owner under the canonical name.

trigger_condition: A new module owner follows the enrollment kit through static PASS and then its run/debug recipe, but no step registers that module/server executable with Platform. The runtime dictionary at PlatformServerBindings.cs:11-20 contains only the existing reference owners; :60-63 refuses an otherwise valid newly mapped sample/Folders/Projects server.
guard_snippet: Add a Platform-owner executable-binding registration prerequisite before run/debug and SM-2, identifying the module/server project path and required local-profile bindings. State that schema/adoption validation can pass before this runtime integration is complete, and tie the handoff to the owning adoption story.
potential_consequence: An owner can complete every published preparation step yet receive mapped source project is unavailable when attempting the advertised development flow. DomainEnrollmentKitTests.cs:12-19 validates schema compatibility only, so that integration gap is not surfaced by the kit acceptance check.
